public_payload.normalized_proposition: From his own estimates, he expects Magnificent Seven capital expenditures to have crested $200 billion in the first half of 2025.
conditions: Magnificent Seven alone, first half of 2025

statement.excerpt: One would think two different articles on this subject would include that number versus a single quarter’s worth, but from my estimates, I expect capital expenditures from the Magnificent Seven alone to crest $200 billion in the first half of 2025, with Axios estimating they’d spend around $400 billion this year.

our_interpretation: This is an estimate of an already completed period, despite the word “expect”; it is not a future forecast.
Magnificent Seven means Alphabet, Amazon, Apple, Meta, Microsoft, NVIDIA, and Tesla.
“Crest $200 billion” means exceed USD 200 billion in combined realized capital expenditure during January–June 2025.
The quoted proposition concerns total capital expenditure by those companies. The surrounding AI discussion does not make every expenditure AI-related or U.S.-located.
The cash-flow discussion suggests capital spending, but treatment of finance leases, proceeds, incentives, and accrued additions is not specified.
The Axios full-year estimate is attribution and context, not a second threshold being scored.
criteria.support_condition: A reproducible, period-aligned total for all seven companies exceeds USD 200 billion on a stated capital-expenditure basis consistent with the claim.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A reproducible, period-aligned total is USD 200 billion or less, with reconciliation showing that reasonable treatment of the unspecified capex components does not reverse the result.
